meta.title: Deru: brand and packaging for coffee | Renee
meta.description: Logo, characters and packaging system for a coffee brand: applied to cups, lids, boxes and ice-cream cups at no extra cost.

name: Deru
summary: A coffee brand with its own characters that stays recognisable from cup to gift box.
challenge: The brand had to work across many packaging formats without making production more expensive.
solution: Running, grabbing and laughing coffee cups form a character system that can be applied freely to any format.
result: The system was applied to cups, lids, boxes, ice-cream cups and pastry packaging at no extra cost.
